description: BECOME A STREET RACING LEGEND Dominate your criminally insane rivals in extreme head-to-head drag races. Reach impossible speeds by expertly timing gear changes and bursts of nitro. Drive 69 cars, beat 20 criminal overlords and become the biggest fish in the city. Top Speed is setting the new standard within drag racing genre. Have you ever wanted to participate in underground races against unpredictable mafia mobs? Drive top class luxury cars and show everybody who's the boss? Jump right behind the wheel and get ready to have your breath taken away the moment you push that nitro button. In To
